title: Dorset named among the most haunted counties in the UK with 323 ghost reports
excerpt: Dorset named UK's sixth most haunted county, with 323 ghost reports, including a headless woman at Corfe Castle and sightings across Poole and Christchurch.
content:
Corfe Castle is said to be haunted by a headless woman who reportedly walks the hill near the gateway, while the sound of a galloping horse has also been reported at the base of the castle hill. (Image: Daily Echo)

A headless woman roaming castle grounds is just one of more than 300 ghost sightings recorded in Dorset.

The county has been named the sixth most haunted in the UK, with 323 ghost reports logged in the Paranormal Database, according to travel specialists Ski Vertigo.

Poole leads the county with 20 reported sightings, followed by Christchurch with 16, and both Blandford Forum and Dorchester with 14 each.

Corfe Castle is said to be haunted by a headless woman who reportedly walks the hill near the gateway, while the sound of a galloping horse has also been reported at the base of the castle hill.

Alex Dyer, managing director at Ski Vertigo, said: "Halloween falls at the end of half-term this year, so a lot of families will be after a day out with a good story behind it.

"Plenty of these ghosts belong to castles, abbeys and old pubs you can actually visit, which makes them an easy trip with older children.

"Evening ghost tours can book up quickly in October, so it’s worth reserving early, and with the clocks going back on Sunday 25 October it will be dark an hour earlier that week."

Essex topped the UK list with 422 ghost reports, followed by Sussex with 404 ghost reporters and Kent with 374 ghost reports.
